name: OSHA Violation
subtitle: Animated relics. Ancient enchantments. Absolutely no regard for workplace safety.

identity.mission: Bello awakens forgotten relics and ancient enchantments into enormous, indestructible attackers. Every permanent should feel at home in an overgrown magical workshop where abandoned curiosities have come alive.

pillars.name: Enchanted Relics
pillars.description: Artifacts should feel storied, strange, and recently awakened.

pillars.name: Living Wilderness
pillars.description: Forests, vines, wood, moss, and elemental magic unite the deck.

pillars.name: Joyful Chaos
pillars.description: The deck should feel whimsical even while producing absurd combat steps.

identity.selection_rule: Rarity alone never determines the definitive printing.
